en: Use the arrow keys (or the buttons) to move.
Collect every banana, but don't let the guard catch you!
Change the code: make the guard faster, add a second guard, or give points.
sk: Pozbieraj všetky banány, ale nedaj sa chytiť strážcovi!
Zmeň kód: zrýchli strážcu, pridaj druhého alebo rozdávaj body.

lesson: # Round 1: make the animal move with the arrow keys.

goal.en: Write `def on_key(key):` and call `go(key)` inside it.
Make `class Guard(Critter):` with an `on_tick(self)` that steps, and put one in the world.
goal.sk: Urob `class Guard(Critter):` s `on_tick(self)`, ktorá kráča, a jedného daj do sveta.

goal.en: Pick a twist card and add it to your game. Then press "Test my game".
goal.sk: Vyber si kartu s nápadom a pridaj ho do hry. Potom stlač „Otestuj moju hru“.
